div.p: This case-sensitive code system http://fhirfli.dev/fhir/ig/cicada/CodeSystem/series-type defines the following codes:

tr.td: A series indicated by a patient risk condition, such as travel, occupation, pregnancy, or a chronic medical condition.
A series used only to evaluate administered doses; it never produces a forecast.

description.value: CDSi series type: whether a patient series is the routine schedule, one indicated by a risk condition, or evaluation-only. Mirrors the seriesType attribute of the CDSi antigen supporting data.

definition.value: A series indicated by a patient risk condition, such as travel, occupation, pregnancy, or a chronic medical condition.
A series used only to evaluate administered doses; it never produces a forecast.
